# sync.

> > Studio-grade lipsync and visual dubbing platform powered by advanced AI models for multilingual video content creation.

sync. is an AI-powered video dubbing and lipsync platform that enables creators to generate studio-quality lipsync, emotion editing, and voice cloning without reshoots. The platform offers both API access for developers and web-based tools for professionals working with 4K video content.

## Key Topics

- lipsync-2-pro
- react-1
- video dubbing
- AI emotion editing
- multilingual support
- 4K video
- API integration
- voice cloning
- Active Speaker Detection
- Batch API
- SDKs (Python, TypeScript)
- studio-grade quality
- visual effects
- text-to-speech
- professional video

## Core Platform

- [sync. - studio-grade lipsync and visual dubbing](https://sync.so): sync. homepage: studio-grade lipsync and visual dubbing platform
- [lipsync-2-pro | studio-grade lipsync](https://sync.so/lipsync-2-pro): lipsync-2-pro: advanced AI lipsync model supporting 4K multilingual video
- [react-1: ai emotion editing for video](https://sync.so/react-1): react-1: AI emotion editing tool for video performances without reshoots
